mcqs.question: What was the nature of the India–Germany agreement on wetlands signed in New Delhi in September 2026?
options: A Joint Declaration of Intent on the conservation and “wise use” of Ramsar wetlands
The Montreux Record for Ramsar sites with adverse ecological change
The Ramsar Convention on wetlands adopted at Ramsar, Iran
World Wetlands Day observed on February 2
mcqs.explanation: India and Germany signed a Joint Declaration of Intent on the conservation and “wise use” of Ramsar wetlands. The Montreux Record is instead associated with Ramsar sites facing adverse ecological change, so it is not the agreement signed in September 2026.
